top.title: Roche's Enicepatide Shows Weight Loss, HbA1c Gains in Phase II Study
top.summary: Roche reported positive Phase II results for enicepatide, its once-weekly dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist, showing dose-dependent HbA1c reductions of 2.65% and body weight loss of 15.5% at the 24 mg dose in type 2 diabetes patients.
